Lifecycle state of the affair, derived from OpenParlData events.title_harmonized (full stream 2026-10-13: 84 raw harmonized titles, 328 nonempty; affairs.state and affairs.state_name_harmonized are dead). LoV is the curated 14-value canonical normalisation of the measured enum; the import file maps every raw title onto one of these (e.g. Beantwortung -> BEANTWORTET, Bereit zur Traktandierung -> TRAKTANDIERT, Uberwiesen/Weisung/Zuweisung an Kommission -> UEBERWIESEN, Im/Vom Parlament behandelt -> BEHANDELT, Abgeschlossen -> ERLEDIGT). The 14 canonical values cover ~70 % of event rows; the long-tail request/deadline vocabulary stays unmapped. Note: the former T13 seed value in Treatment does not occur in the archived corpus and was withdrawn.

Parliamentary instrument of the affair, mirroring OpenParlData type_harmonized (measured on the full affairs stream 2026-10-13: 17 values, filled on 83.1 %, top-heavy Anfrage/Interpellation/Regierungsgeschäft/Motion/Postulat ~62 % of filled). LoV values are the harmonized German labels normalised to UPPER_SNAKE (umlauts expanded: REGIERUNGSGESCHAFT, EINBUERGERUNG, ERGAENZUNGSANTRAG); the import file maps raw values onto them. Wikidata bridge on 68.2 % (type_wikidata) is kept as an affair attribute, not here. use_as_document_label candidate (C-4, pending T12).
